field.label: Enabled
field.help: This will enable or disable the instance.

field.label: Name
field.help: Set the name for this instance.

field.label: Instance
field.help: This is the instance number to give the AmneziaWG device a unique name (wgX).

field.label: Public key
field.help: Public key of this instance. You can specify your own one, or generate one with the gear button.

field.label: Private key
field.help: Private key of this instance. You can specify your own one, or generate one with the gear button. Please keep this key safe.

field.label: Listen port
field.help: Optionally set a fixed port for this instance to listen on. The standard port range starts at 51820.

field.label: MTU
field.help: Set a specific device MTU for this instance.

field.label: DNS servers
field.help: Set specific DNS servers for this instance. Use with care.

field.label: Tunnel address
field.help: List of addresses to configure on the device. Please use CIDR notation like 10.0.0.1/24.

field.label: Depend on (CARP)
field.help: The CARP VHID to depend on. When this virtual address is not in master state, then the instance will be shutdown.

field.label: Peers
field.help: List of peers for this instance.

field.label: Disable routes
field.help: This will prevent installing routes. Usually you only enable this to do own routing decisions via a local gateway and gateway rules.

field.label: Gateway
field.help: Set the gateway IP here when using "Disable routes" feature. You also have to add this as a system gateway.

field.label: Debug Log
field.help: Enable the debug flag on this instance for enhanced error logging.

field.label: AmneziaWG 2.0
field.help: Protocol to imitate when the gear button generates new parameters. Random generates the parameters without imitating a protocol. HTTP/3 or QUIC is recommended for captive portal networks. The parameters are shown in advanced mode, peers need the new configuration.

field.label: Header size
field.help: Bytes added to every data packet: the IP header (20 for IPv4, 40 for IPv6), UDP (8) and WireGuard (32) are 60 and 80 bytes, AmneziaWG adds S4 and, with AmneziaWG 3.x, the content padding (a range adds a random amount). Measured with amnezia-kmod 3.1.0. The MTU of the tunnel interface is lowered by the kernel module for S4 only, in steps of 16: 1420 up to S4 12, 1408 for S4 13-28, 1392 for 29-44, 1376 for 45-60 and so on, not for the content padding. An MTU set in this instance is used as it is.

field.label: Junk packet count (Jc)
field.help: Number of junk packets sent before each handshake, 0-128 (recommended 3-10). Leave all obfuscation fields empty for plain WireGuard compatibility.

field.label: Junk packet minimum size (Jmin)
field.help: Minimum size of a junk packet, must be smaller than Jmax (recommended about 8).

field.label: Junk packet maximum size (Jmax)
field.help: Maximum size of a junk packet, up to 1280 (recommended about 80).

field.label: Init packet prefix (S1)
field.help: Random prefix length of handshake initiation packets, 0-1304 (recommended 15-150). Must match on both ends.

field.label: Response packet prefix (S2)
field.help: Random prefix length of handshake response packets, 0-1360 (recommended 15-150). Must match on both ends.

field.label: Cookie padding (S3)
field.help: Random prefix length of cookie reply packets, 0-1388 (recommended 15-150). Must match on both ends.

field.label: Transport padding (S4)
field.help: Random prefix length of transport data packets, 0-160 (recommended 15-32). Lowers the usable MTU of the interface. Must match on both ends.

field.label: Header initiation (H1)
field.help: Number or range a-b from 5 to 4294967295 (a range picks a random value per packet). Must match on both ends. Values and ranges must not overlap. Leave empty for the standard WireGuard value.

field.label: Header response (H2)
field.help: Number or range a-b from 5 to 4294967295 (a range picks a random value per packet). Must match on both ends. Values and ranges must not overlap. Leave empty for the standard WireGuard value.

field.label: Header cookie reply (H3)
field.help: Number or range a-b from 5 to 4294967295 (a range picks a random value per packet). Must match on both ends. Values and ranges must not overlap. Leave empty for the standard WireGuard value.

field.label: Header transport (H4)
field.help: Number or range a-b from 5 to 4294967295 (a range picks a random value per packet). Must match on both ends. Values and ranges must not overlap. Leave empty for the standard WireGuard value.

field.label: Signature packet I1
field.help: CPS chain, e.g. <b 0x...><r 32><t>. Sent before the handshake.

field.label: Signature packet I2
field.help: CPS chain, e.g. <b 0x...><r 32><t>. Sent before the handshake.

field.label: Signature packet I3
field.help: CPS chain, e.g. <b 0x...><r 32><t>. Sent before the handshake.

field.label: Signature packet I4
field.help: CPS chain, e.g. <b 0x...><r 32><t>. Sent before the handshake.

field.label: Signature packet I5
field.help: CPS chain, e.g. <b 0x...><r 32><t>. Sent before the handshake.

field.label: Enable AmneziaWG 3.x
field.help: Use the AmneziaWG 3.x parameters below (shown in advanced mode). When this is off they are kept but not applied.

field.label: Header protection key
field.help: 32 byte base64 key that encrypts packet headers. Must match on both ends. Requires S1-S4 of at least 12. Requires amnezia-kmod and amnezia-tools 3.x, older versions reject this key and the instance will not start.

field.label: Content padding addition
field.help: Random number of bytes added to transport packets, as a number or range a-b, up to 65535. Requires amnezia-kmod and amnezia-tools 3.x, older versions reject this key and the instance will not start.

field.label: Rekey after time
field.help: Interval before a new handshake is started. Number or range a-b, up to 65535. Requires amnezia-kmod and amnezia-tools 3.x, older versions reject this key and the instance will not start.

field.label: Rekey timeout
field.help: Handshake timeout. Number or range a-b, up to 65535. Requires amnezia-kmod and amnezia-tools 3.x, older versions reject this key and the instance will not start.

field.label: Reject after time
field.help: Interval after which the connection initiates a new handshake. Number or range a-b, up to 65535. Requires amnezia-kmod and amnezia-tools 3.x, older versions reject this key and the instance will not start.

field.label: Keepalive timeout
field.help: Interval before a keepalive is sent. Number or range a-b, up to 65535. Requires amnezia-kmod and amnezia-tools 3.x, older versions reject this key and the instance will not start.

field.label: Max handshake attempts
field.help: Maximum number of handshake retries. Number or range a-b, up to 65535. Requires amnezia-kmod and amnezia-tools 3.x, older versions reject this key and the instance will not start.

field.label: Random trailers
field.help: Adds random trailers to packets so handshake packets no longer have a fixed length. Must be the same on both ends, the handshake fails otherwise. The Amnezia documentation recommends the same values for S1-S4 when this is enabled. Requires AmneziaWG 3.1 (amnezia-kmod and amnezia-tools 3.x), older versions reject this key and the instance will not start.

field.label: Disable cookies
field.help: Disables sending handshake cookie reply messages. Requires AmneziaWG 3.1 (amnezia-kmod and amnezia-tools 3.x), older versions reject this key and the instance will not start.

field.label: Endpoint
field.help: The endpoint that the instance will be reachable at, only used by the Peer generator.

field.label: DNS Servers
field.help: The DNS Servers to use when peers connect, only used by the Peer generator.

field.label: Allowed IPs
field.help: The Allowed IPs to use when peers connect, only used by the Peer generator.
